set-level: true mouth west / centre / east at least 2 each, tunnel roof flat / lean at least 4 each, seeds and geometry of practice and hidden disjoint and distinct from the development and calibration sites; the cue check (family-wise)

fallbacks: extend the pool in seed order (hidden 181-260, practice 531-560), then relax the shares, then stop and report; the episode seed of a site is its site seed; time limit 60 s x ceil(1.6 x the longest reference time over the 13 selected sites / 60 s); anchor = the reference's mean through the real verify.py, twice
